AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_spot_actions usa WHERE usa.user_id = #{userId} AND usa.target_type = 'poi' AND usa.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) AND usa.action_type = 'dislike' AND usa.active = 1 )

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id, s.id) AS id, s.id AS spotId, s.legacy_place_group_id AS placeGroupId, s.name, c.code AS category, c.name AS categoryName, s.rating AS score, s.rating AS rating, s.hotness, s.visit_count AS visits, s.cover_image AS image, s.description, s.spot_type AS spotType, s.province, s.city FROM spots s LEFT JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.status = 1 AND NOT ( s.spot_type = 'university' AND s.legacy_place_group_id IS NOT NULL AND s.representative_poi_id IS NULL AND s.legacy_poi_id IS NULL ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.legacy_place_group_id = 3 THEN 1 WHEN s.legacy_place_group_id = 4 THEN 2 WHEN s.legacy_place_group_id = 5 THEN 3 WHEN s.legacy_place_group_id = 6 THEN 4 ELSE 100 END ASC, s.hotness DESC, s.rating DESC, s.visit_count DESC, s.id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id, s.id) AS id, s.id AS spotId, s.legacy_place_group_id AS placeGroupId, s.name, c.code AS category, c.name AS categoryName, s.rating AS score, s.rating AS rating, s.hotness, s.visit_count AS visits, s.cover_image AS image, s.description, s.spot_type AS spotType, s.province, s.city FROM spots s LEFT JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.status = 1 AND NOT ( s.spot_type = 'university' AND s.legacy_place_group_id IS NOT NULL AND s.representative_poi_id IS NULL AND s.legacy_poi_id IS NULL )

SELECT COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id, s.id) AS id, s.id AS spotId, s.name, s.cover_image AS image, s.description, c.code AS category, c.name AS categoryName, s.rating AS score, s.rating AS rating, 0 AS distance, s.visit_count AS visits, s.hotness, s.legacy_place_group_id AS placeGroupId, s.spot_type AS spotType, s.province, s.city, COALESCE(pg.route_graph_status, 'none') AS routeGraphStatus, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM foods f JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = f.poi_id WHERE f.status = 1 AND ( fp.spot_id = s.id OR fp.place_group_id = s.legacy_place_group_id ) ), 0) AS foodCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_logs tl JOIN pois lp ON lp.id = tl.poi_id WHERE tl.status = 1 AND ( lp.spot_id = s.id OR lp.place_group_id = s.legacy_place_group_id ) ), 0) AS logCount, COALESCE(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.name ORDER BY t.name SEPARATOR '、') FROM spot_tag_relations str JOIN tags t ON t.id = str.tag_id WHERE str.spot_id = s.id ), '') AS tagNames, DATE_FORMAT(rp.open_time, '%H:%i') AS openTime, DATE_FORMAT(rp.close_time, '%H:%i') AS closeTime, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM favorites f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 'poi' AND f.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS favoriteMatched, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_spot_actions usa WHERE usa.user_id = #{userId} AND usa.target_type = 'poi' AND usa.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) AND usa.action_type = 'want' AND usa.active = 1 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS wantMatched, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_spot_actions usa WHERE usa.user_id = #{userId} AND usa.target_type = 'poi' AND usa.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) AND usa.action_type = 'visited' AND usa.active = 1 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS visitedMatched, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_spot_actions usa WHERE usa.user_id = #{userId} AND usa.target_type = 'poi' AND usa.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) AND usa.action_type = 'dislike' AND usa.active = 1 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS dislikeMatched, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM browsing_history bh WHERE bh.user_id = #{userId} AND bh.target_type = 'poi' AND bh.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) ), 0) AS browseCount, COALESCE(( SELECT r.rating FROM ratings r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.target_type = 'poi' AND r.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) LIMIT 1 ), 0) AS userRating, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(up.weight) FROM user_preferences up JOIN spot_tag_relations str ON str.tag_id = up.tag_id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND str.spot_id = s.id ), 0) AS preferenceScore, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT interacted_spot.id) FROM ( SELECT p.spot_id AS spot_id FROM favorites f JOIN pois p ON p.id = f.target_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 'poi' UNION ALL SELECT p.spot_id AS spot_id FROM user_spot_actions usa JOIN pois p ON p.id = usa.target_id WHERE usa.user_id = #{userId} AND usa.target_type = 'poi' AND usa.active = 1 UNION ALL SELECT p.spot_id AS spot_id FROM browsing_history bh JOIN pois p ON p.id = bh.target_id WHERE bh.user_id = #{userId} AND bh.target_type = 'poi' ) user_actions JOIN spots interacted_spot ON interacted_spot.id = user_actions.spot_id WHERE interacted_spot.id != s.id AND ( interacted_spot.category_id = s.category_id OR interacted_spot.spot_type = s.spot_type ) ), 0) AS similarActionCount, ( s.hotness * 0.18 + s.visit_count * 0.08 + s.rating * 20 + COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(up.weight) * 30 FROM user_preferences up JOIN spot_tag_relations str ON str.tag_id = up.tag_id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND str.spot_id = s.id ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) * 20 FROM browsing_history bh WHERE bh.user_id = #{userId} AND bh.target_type = 'poi' AND bh.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) * 80 FROM favorites f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 'poi' AND f.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(CASE usa.action_type WHEN 'want' THEN 90 WHEN 'visited' THEN 25 WHEN 'dislike' THEN -260 ELSE 0 END) FROM user_spot_actions usa WHERE usa.user_id = #{userId} AND usa.target_type = 'poi' AND usa.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) AND usa.active = 1 ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT r.rating * 12 FROM ratings r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.target_type = 'poi' AND r.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) LIMIT 1 ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT interacted_spot.id) * 18 FROM ( SELECT p.spot_id AS spot_id FROM favorites f JOIN pois p ON p.id = f.target_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 'poi' UNION ALL SELECT p.spot_id AS spot_id FROM user_spot_actions usa JOIN pois p ON p.id = usa.target_id WHERE usa.user_id = #{userId} AND usa.target_type = 'poi' AND usa.active = 1 UNION ALL SELECT p.spot_id AS spot_id FROM browsing_history bh JOIN pois p ON p.id = bh.target_id WHERE bh.user_id = #{userId} AND bh.target_type = 'poi' ) user_actions JOIN spots interacted_spot ON interacted_spot.id = user_actions.spot_id WHERE interacted_spot.id != s.id AND ( interacted_spot.category_id = s.category_id OR interacted_spot.spot_type = s.spot_type ) ), 0) + CASE WHEN #{purpose} = 'photo' AND (c.code IN ('scenic', 'natural', 'waterfront', 'landmark') OR s.description LIKE '%拍照%' OR s.description LIKE '%打卡%') THEN 180 WHEN #{purpose} = 'study' AND (s.spot_type IN ('campus', 'university', 'museum') OR c.code IN ('museum', 'historic', 'memorial')) THEN 180 WHEN #{purpose} = 'food' THEN COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) * 45 FROM foods f JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = f.poi_id WHERE f.status = 1 AND ( fp.spot_id = s.id OR fp.place_group_id = s.legacy_place_group_id ) ), 0) WHEN #{purpose} = 'relax' AND (s.spot_type IN ('park', 'scenic') OR c.code IN ('scenic', 'natural', 'waterfront')) THEN 160 WHEN #{purpose} = 'route' AND COALESCE(pg.route_graph_status, 'none') IN ('draft', 'verified') THEN 200 ELSE 0 END ) AS recommendScore FROM spots s LEFT JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = s.category_id LEFT JOIN pois rp ON rp.id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) LEFT JOIN place_groups pg ON pg.id = s.legacy_place_group_id WHERE
ORDER BY recommendScore DESC, s.rating DESC, s.id ASC
ORDER BY s.rating DESC, s.hotness DESC, s.visit_count DESC, s.id ASC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.legacy_place_group_id = 3 THEN 1 WHEN s.legacy_place_group_id = 4 THEN 2 WHEN s.legacy_place_group_id = 5 THEN 3 WHEN s.legacy_place_group_id = 6 THEN 4 ELSE 100 END ASC, recommendScore DESC, s.hotness DESC, s.rating DESC, s.visit_count DESC, s.id ASC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pois WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM foods WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_logs WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ratings (user_id, target_type, target_id, rating) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{rating}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rating = VALUES(rating), updated_at = NOW()
